content:
Dear all,

On June 4th 2026, there will be the Dutch Formal Methods Day 2026, this year organized in Eindhoven, The Netherlands! This is a day that aims to bring together computer scientists, mathematicians and data scientists, from both academia and industry.

We are very excited about the two keynote talks, given by Emily Yu from Leiden University and Sebastian Ullrich from the Lean FRO.

The rest of the program will consist of contributed talks, and we are looking forward to your contributions.

This will be an in-person event, and registration is free of charge.

We hope to see many of you there!

Jore Booy and Jim Portegies
